objective: Change `summarize(info)` in `demo_app/version_report.py` so it copes with incomplete input. Define a new exception class `InvalidInfo`, a subclass of `ValueError`, in the same module `demo_app/version_report.py`. `summarize` still returns `amplai <package_version> (<stage>)` for complete input. If the `stage` key is missing or its value is the empty string, the stage part becomes the literal text `unknown stage`, so the result is `amplai <package_version> (unknown stage)`. If the `package_version` key is missing, or its value is not a `str`, or its value is the empty string, `summarize` raises `InvalidInfo`. The `package_version` check applies regardless of the `stage` value. The version text is used exactly as given (no stripping or other changes).
acceptance: summarize({'package_version': '1.2.3'}) returns 'amplai 1.2.3 (unknown stage)' and summarize({'package_version': '1.2.3', 'stage': ''}) returns 'amplai 1.2.3 (unknown stage)'
InvalidInfo is defined in demo_app/version_report.py and issubclass(InvalidInfo, ValueError) is true
summarize raises InvalidInfo when package_version is missing, is an empty string, or is not a str (for example the int 3 or None), whether or not stage is present
Extra keys in info are ignored
